title: MZ Visustella MZ Visual Parallaxes Issue

posts.author: ClownFvx
posts.body:
Hello! I'm using Visual Parallaxes plugin by Visustella for RPG MAKER MZ.
For some reason, when i use parallax, it shows on the whole map, not on region i want it to.
I even changed settings in plugin to region 3,and it still doesn't work. Any idea how can i fix this? Thanks in advance
My note tags are as follow:
<Water Parallax 1 Settings>
Name: Space
Region: 3
Terrain Tag: 3
optional property
</Water Parallax 1 Settings>
<Water Reflection Region: 3>

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Well did you check that you didn't set that Space parallax in the map settings parallax? Did you check that you didn't put terrain tag 3 on your tiles in the database? Did you update your plugins and check for plugin conflicts?

posts.author: ClownFvx
posts.body:
rpgLord69 said:
Well did you check that you didn't set that Space parallax in the map settings parallax? Did you check that you didn't put terrain tag 3 on your tiles in the database? Did you update your plugins and check for plugin conflicts?
Click to expand...
1. Completely different parallaxes.
Even if i create a parallax in an event via plug-in commands, the problem still stands  - replaces the whole background, and does not apply on terrain3 or region3
2. I put them, checked twice, terrain tags are present on water tiles(A1), for test purposes put them on different tilesets - same problem.
3. I only use Visustella Library, latest plugin versions.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Hmmm, don't know, seemed to work for me when I tested it. The parallax only showed on the correct regions, other empty spots were black. My plugins might be a couple months old though.

posts.author: satilte
posts.body: Are you using semi-transparent tiles? I think you need to have to reduce the tile opacity/alpha for the parallax to show through.
